newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Life plans new foreign bond investment.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Life plans new foreign bond investment.

text.p: Nippon Life Insurance Co plans more than 100 billion yen worth of new foreign bond investment in the second half of the current business year, a company official told reporters on Wednesday.

The official said no new stock investments were planned in the second half of the fiscal year to the end of March, because the company's planned stock investments had already been carried out in the first half.
The official said that any new domestic bond investments would depend on market conditions, but he did not provide any specific figures.
